rule.intro: Indefinido tells what happened. Imperfecto describes the background. Perfecto links to now. Pluscuamperfecto goes further back, before another past event.

points.title: Indefinido
examples: finished events: ayer, el lunes, en 2020

points.title: Imperfecto
examples: Hacía sol y había mucha gente.
description and habits: siempre, antes, mientras

points.title: Perfecto
examples: linked to now: hoy, este año, ya, nunca

points.title: Pluscuamperfecto
examples: Nunca había vivido fuera antes de 2020.
before another past moment: había + participle

points.title: Agreement
examples: Marta y su amiga hicieron un curso.
Vi que las calles estaban vacías.
vi que + clause; vi has no accent

rule.watch: From your exam: nunca he vivido → nunca había vivido; me he preparado → me habían preparado; Vi las calles estaban → Vi que las calles estaban. Marta y su amiga → hicieron, aprendieron.

items.q: Antes de 2020, nunca ___ vivido fuera de España.
items.ex: Before a past moment: había + participle.
items.en: Before 2020, I had never lived outside Spain.

items.q: Las decisiones me ___ preparado para aquello.
items.en: The decisions had prepared me for that.
I saw that the streets were empty.

items.q: Marta y su amiga ___ un curso de cocina. (hacer)
items.en: Marta and her friend did a cooking course.
Marta and her friend learned a lot.

items.q: Antes de ese viaje, nunca he vivido fuera.
items.full: Antes de ese viaje, nunca había vivido fuera.
items.en: Before that trip, I had never lived abroad.

items.q: Marta y su amiga hizo un curso.
items.full: Marta y su amiga hicieron un curso.
items.en: Marta and her friend did a course.

items.q: Ví a Juan en la plaza.
items.full: Vi a Juan en la plaza.
items.en: I saw Juan in the square.

items.q: I saw that the streets were empty
items.a: Vi que las calles estaban vacías

items.q: Mi amiga y yo ___ a la playa ayer.
items.ex: Mi amiga y yo = nosotros: fuimos.
items.en: My friend and I went to the beach yesterday.

items.q: La gente ___ muy amable en Japón.
items.en: The people were very nice in Japan.
Yesterday I went to the cinema with Ana.
Today I went to the cinema with Ana.

items.q: Antes siempre ___ al cine los lunes.
items.en: I always used to go to the cinema on Mondays.
When I arrived, the train had already left.
While we were having dinner, the phone rang.
We were having dinner when the phone rang.
Last Saturday it was very hot.
Have you ever been to the Canaries?
I got up late this morning.
In 2020 I moved to Madrid.
As a child I was very shy.
I was tired because I hadn't slept well.
I called my mother yesterday.
I've already read this book.
When I was young, I travelled a lot.

items.q: Hacía sol y los niños ___ en la calle. (jugar)
items.en: It was sunny and the children were playing in the street.

items.q: El lunes ___ a trabajar tarde. (llegar, yo)
items.en: On Monday I got to work late.
My parents came to see me yesterday.
We didn't do anything last night.
Pedro said he couldn't come.
Where were you yesterday?
Ana couldn't come on Friday.
The children had already eaten when we arrived.

items.q: Antes de aquel día, nunca ___ tanta gente en la calle. (ver, yo)
items.ex: Up to that past moment: había visto.
items.en: Before that day, I had never seen so many people in the street.
I've worked a lot this week.

items.q: El año pasado ___ en Valencia. (vivir, yo)
items.en: Last year I lived in Valencia.
When I got home, my brother was sleeping.
It was very cold, so we didn't go out.

items.q: Ayer ___ a Ana, que ___ muy contenta.
items.en: Yesterday I saw Ana, who was very happy.
When we arrived, the concert had already started.
I went to the doctor yesterday.

items.ex: Hoy takes the perfecto in Spain.
items.en: I went to the doctor today.

items.q: Cuando era pequeño, vivía en Utrecht.
items.en: When I was little, I lived in Utrecht.

items.q: Mi amigo y yo fue a Madrid.
items.en: My friend and I went to Madrid.
items.full: Mi amigo y yo fuimos a Madrid.

items.q: El verano pasado ___ a Cádiz con mi novia. ___ mucho calor y la playa ___ llena. Un día ___ en barco y ___ delfines. Por la noche ___ pescado en un bar pequeño. ___ un viaje genial y nunca ___ algo así.
items.ex: Events: indefinido. Background: imperfecto. Earlier: había visto.
items.en: Last summer I went to Cádiz with my girlfriend. It was very hot and the beach was full. One day we went out in a boat and saw dolphins. In the evening we had fish in a small bar. It was a great trip and I had never seen anything like it.

items.q: Cuando ___ niño, ___ en un pueblo. Todos los días ___ al colegio andando. Un día ___ mucho y ___ el autobús. ___ muy contento porque nunca ___ en autobús.
items.ex: Habits: imperfecto. One day: indefinido. Earlier: había ido.
items.en: When I was a child, I lived in a village. Every day I walked to school. One day it rained a lot and I took the bus. I was very happy because I had never gone by bus.

items.q: Marta y su amiga ___ a Madrid en mayo. ___ un curso y ___ mucho. Las clases ___ por la mañana y por la tarde ___ . El último día ___ una fiesta. Nunca lo ___ tan bien. Después ___ a casa.
items.en: Marta and her friend went to Madrid in May. They did a course and learned a lot. Classes were in the morning and in the afternoon they went for walks. On the last day there was a party. They had never had such a good time. Then they went back home.

items.q: Ayer ___ un día horrible. ___ tarde porque no ___ el despertador. ___ mucho y no ___ paraguas. En la oficina ___ una reunión y mi jefe ___ muy enfadado. Por la noche ___ en el sofá.
items.en: Yesterday was a horrible day. I got up late because I didn't hear the alarm. It was raining hard and I didn't have an umbrella. At the office there was a meeting and my boss was very angry. At night I fell asleep on the sofa.

items.q: Cuando ___ a Madrid, no ___ a nadie. ___ un piso pequeño y ___ mucho. Un día ___ a Ana, que ___ en mi edificio. Antes nunca ___ fuera de casa. Ahora ___ muy feliz aquí.
items.ex: Event, background, earlier past, then now.
items.en: When I arrived in Madrid, I didn't know anyone. I rented a small flat and worked a lot. One day I met Ana, who lived in my building. I had never lived away from home before. Now I'm very happy here.

items.q: El sábado ___ a la montaña. ___ sol y no ___ nadie. ___ tres horas y ___ junto a un río. Al volver, vi que ___ el coche abierto. Por suerte, nadie ___ nada.
items.ex: Events: indefinido. Background: imperfecto. Earlier: pluscuamperfecto.
items.en: On Saturday we went to the mountains. It was sunny and there was nobody there. We walked for three hours and ate by a river. On returning, I saw that I had left the car open. Luckily, nobody had stolen anything.
